Command palette results flicker on fast typing

Typing quickly in the command palette re-renders the results on every keystroke - the list flickers and the highlighted row jumps back to the first item.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Press ⌘K
  2. Type assign to as fast as you can
  3. Watch the highlighted row

Expected: results update once typing pauses, and the highlight stays on the same command.
